Beyond Madness - a word of warning.

No bolster here (except on starting maps).

Quest timing matters:
- Finish early: immediate power now, less XP.
- Finish late: bigger XP later, no early power.

Run-wide tracking:
- On the character screen, you'll see a death counter shared across all saves of this run.
- On the map, a red counter appears after you take damage and clears when no monsters are nearby.
- Loading or leaving the game while that counter is red counts as a death.

- 카운터가 빨간 상태에서 게임을 불러오거나 종료하면 사망 1회로 계산됩니다.
